gradingRules.extraction: Preserve original meaning, qualifiers and attribution collectively; opinions must yield no factual claims. Separate semantic preservation from frozen exact count. Faithful decomposition can pass semantic extraction while failing frozen count.
gradingRules.conditionalSupport: Grade a factual extracted claim against supplied bodies. Nonfactual personal preferences/value judgments are not applicable. A conditional pass cannot rescue an altered original claim.
gradingRules.evidenceRelevance: A passage must bear on the extracted claim beyond a shared entity mention. Context may pass without entailing. No-passage claims are not counted as relevance passes.
gradingRules.coverage: Positive/contradicted factual targets require accepted relevant evidence that addresses their full meaning. Unsupported and opinion targets are not applicable to this requirement.
gradingRules.originalPostTaskFaithfulness: Conjunction of semantic extraction, including opinion gating, and source-relative original-meaning disposition. Excludes rationale-quality scoring and does not replace the frozen exact-signature score.

reviewReuse.explanation: All 27 distinct family/claim/status/canonical-source/quote/relation patterns and 16 quote/relation patterns were inspected. Reused judgments across identical patterns, then checked each case post, ID mapping, variant, and returned claim structure. Case reasons are mapped explicitly; this is not 54 independent reviews.
reviewReuse.corePatternDefinition: Family, ordered extracted claim texts/statuses and evidence canonical source key/quote/relation. Source IDs and display metadata are canonicalized for this grouping; explanation text is not part of its equality signature.
reviewReuse.baselineReview: Read all 54 individual baseline label/reason pairs. Reused source-relative family judgments for equivalent variants and explicitly checked the date mismatch, opinion labels, and failed-retrieval probe.
